title: Two Octanuclear {Cu4Ln4} (Ln = Dy or Tb) Complexes with a Butterfly-Shaped Unit Exhibiting Zero-Field Single-Molecule Magnet Behavior

material_class.structural_family: octanuclear {Cu4Dy4} cluster built from two butterfly-shaped {Cu2Dy2L2} units

synthesis.procedure: Ligand H3L (0.0098 g, 0.03 mmol) was deprotonated with NaOH (0.0036 g, 0.09 mmol) in MeOH (1 mL) and MeCN (4 mL) by stirring for 5–10 min under aerobic conditions. Dy(ClO4)3·9H2O (0.03 mmol) and CuCl2·3H2O (0.0051 g, 0.03 mmol) were added and the mixture was stirred at room temperature for an additional 1 h, then filtered. Dark green crystals of 1 suitable for X-ray diffraction were isolated after 2 weeks by slow evaporation of the solvent.
synthesis.time: 5–10 min deprotonation, then 1 h stirring; crystals after 2 weeks
synthesis.vessel_or_method: one-pot aerobic solution reaction followed by filtration and slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: The resulting solution was filtered; dark green crystals were isolated after 2 weeks by slow evaporation of the solvent.

properties.summary: Zero-field SMM: dc data show ferromagnetic CuII–DyIII coupling and magnetic anisotropy; ac data under Hdc = 0 give temperature- and frequency-dependent χ′ and χ″, Ueff = 54 K and τ0 = 2.18 × 10−9 s, with two Cole–Cole relaxation processes at 2.0–3.0 K and one process at 3.2–10 K. Only a very narrow hysteresis is seen at 2 K.

measurements.name: χT (minimum)
measurements.conditions: upon cooling from 300 to 45 K; Hdc = 1000 Oe

measurements.name: magnetization
measurements.conditions: 7.0 T; M vs H also at 2, 3, and 5 K (0–7 T)

measurements.name: Ueff/kB
measurements.conditions: Arrhenius fit of τ from χ″ maxima; Hac = 2.0 Oe, Hdc = 0

material_class.structural_family: octanuclear {Cu4Tb4} cluster isostructural with 1; two butterfly-shaped {Cu2Tb2L2} units

synthesis.procedure: Same one-pot procedure as 1, replacing Dy(ClO4)3·9H2O with Tb(ClO4)3·9H2O (0.03 mmol). H3L (0.0098 g, 0.03 mmol) was deprotonated with NaOH (0.0036 g, 0.09 mmol) in MeOH (1 mL)/MeCN (4 mL) for 5–10 min; Tb(ClO4)3·9H2O (0.03 mmol) and CuCl2·3H2O (0.0051 g, 0.03 mmol) were added and stirred 1 h at room temperature, then filtered. Dark green crystals of 2 formed after 2 weeks by slow evaporation.
synthesis.time: 5–10 min deprotonation, then 1 h stirring; crystals after 2 weeks
synthesis.vessel_or_method: one-pot aerobic solution reaction followed by filtration and slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: The resulting solution was filtered; dark green crystals were isolated after 2 weeks by slow evaporation of the solvent.

properties.summary: Isostructural Cu4Tb4 analogue showing ferromagnetic CuII–TbIII coupling and anisotropy. Zero-field ac susceptibility is temperature- and frequency-dependent, indicating slow relaxation, but χ″ maxima are not observed over the measured frequency range so Ueff could not be determined; only one weak low-T Cole–Cole process is reported.
